tokens.typography: Inter/system UI; use 450-500 for body, 550-600 for labels/actions and 600-650 for headings; avoid blanket bold. Use tabular numerals for metrics and monospace only for fingerprints/raw evidence.
tokens.control_height: 32px compact; 36px default; 40px only for high-emphasis or touch-constrained contexts
tokens.radius: 7px controls; 10px panels; 14px major surfaces; pills only for semantic status or compact segmented controls
tokens.elevation: canvas and inline surfaces stay flat; raised surfaces use subtle border plus two-layer shadow; strong elevation is reserved for dialogs, menus and overlays
tokens.borders: border_subtle separates low-priority regions; border is the default interactive/data separator; border_strong is reserved for focus, selected or deliberately emphasized boundaries

style.direction: Precision Instrument: light-first, calm off-white workspace, neutral graphite text, evidence-first, high-density without visual noise; dark remains an optional user preference.
style.reference_qualities: Linear hierarchy and restraint; Raycast polish and compact control treatment; Vercel neutral technical precision. Never copy brand-specific chrome or identity.
style.accent_usage: primary accent is sparse and semantic: focus, selected state, key evidence affordance or primary action. Do not use accent simultaneously for generic links, progress, navigation, cards and decorative emphasis.
style.surface_language: Light is canonical: use an off-white canvas, white raised surfaces and a quiet light sidebar. Prefer hierarchy from spacing, typography and controlled depth before borders. Dark preserves the same composition and semantic roles rather than becoming a separate design.
style.evidence_language: Quality, Performance and Resources keep distinct semantic identifiers. Rails/markers may encode availability, trustworthy ranges, confidence or relative position only when the evidence supports that encoding; never imply an invented normalized score and never render unknown/unavailable/not-comparable as zero.
style.iconography: simple outline icons with consistent 1.5-2px stroke; compact and quiet; never decorative when text is clearer
style.motion: short functional transitions only; motion communicates feedback, continuity, progress or state change and honors reduced-motion preferences
style.imagery: no decorative stock imagery, glassmorphism or ornamental gradients in core workflows; charts and evidence visuals must encode real data
style.voice_microcopy: decision-first and concise. Essential outcome/status comes first; contextual protocol/provenance copy moves behind existing disclosure affordances when it is not required for trust or recovery.
style.premium_quality_bar: no accidental wrapping, inconsistent baselines, oversized CTA treatment, noisy dividers, ambiguous disabled states or visually equal hierarchy between primary decisions and secondary diagnostics

spring.default: n/a - restrained CSS transitions are canonical

motion_tokens.reduced_motion_strategy: remove non-essential transitions and spatial movement while preserving immediate state, focus and progress feedback
